messages:
ashok: Heads-up — planning a 3h surge test tomorrow 10:00 SGT for the live demo. Need roughly +8 A100s in asia-southeast1. Can we borrow from standby or get a quick quota bump? Also need infra CR on PR #8422 (batching toggles).

maria: I can check spare quota now, pinging oncall-bot for current slot counts.

oncall-bot: Automated: current spare A100 slots (asia-southeast1): 2 free. Standby pool: 6 reserved (not literaly free). Predicted frees after 02:00UTC: 0.

jamie: We only have 2 truly free right now. Can we reduce target from +8 -> +6 by lowering concurrency?

ashok: Yeah we can drop concurrency. Minimum GPUs to hit throughput target (~40k tokens/min) is 6 if we also disable heavy KV warmup. Can vendor fill remaining 2 if needed?

sasha: Vendor side (partner OVH) reports 4 A100-equivalent nodes available but with ~25ms extra egress. They can be a fallback. Also we need infra review on the TF change in the PR — Maria, can you take the CR?

maria: On it, grabbing CR in ~30m. PR link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/8422

jamie: If we skip full KV warmup and pre-populate a small prefix cache we cut per-token latency and reduce reqs. Quick snippet: 
```
# quick client change to skip warmup
if env.TEST_SURGE:
    client.warmup(enabled=False)
```

ashok: Good. Plan: request 6 A100s in asia-southeast1 (use standby borrow for +2 if possible). Maria to submit vendor fallback ticket by 20:00 PT if quota not confirmed. I'll also throttle concurrency in the test runner.

maria: Filing internal ticket INC-4589 to track quota + vendor fallback. Putting a cloud-support request now.

oncall-bot: Note: cloud-support ticket created (CS-123456) — provider ETA for quota change: up to 24h.

jamie: OK — I'll reconfigure the run to target 6 GPUs and queue the job. Will update the runbook with fallback steps and the PR id. :thumbsup:

ashok: Thanks — 15min preflight at 09:30 SGT (calendar invite sent). If anyone hits blocking CR comments, ping here and I'll triage.

maria: ACK, will post status in this thread when quota/vendor confirm.

sasha: Adding a tiny TF resource snippet I'll attach to the ticket to request standby borrow: 
```
resource "redwood_gpu_borrow" "surge-demo" {
  region = "asia-southeast1"
  count  = 2
  reason = "demo surge 10:00 SGT"
}
```

ashok: Perfect. Thanks all.
